moments.title: A headset that trains your brain's flow state
moments.insight: Steve describes Think, a headset that reads brainwaves to help users enter a flow state even under pressure, like a superpower.

moments.title: Billions spent on ed-tech, kids aren't improving
moments.insight: Despite billions poured into school technology, standardized test scores haven't improved—but six weeks of this training raises scores a full grade level.

moments.title: Why big companies won't build this
moments.insight: Big gaming companies profit from dopamine-driven addiction, not cognitive training that requires sustained effort like going to the gym.

moments.title: ADHD training as effective as medication
moments.insight: Eight clinical trials showed the technology works as well as medication for ADHD, and attention issues underlie nearly all major mental health diagnoses.

moments.title: The brain has hundreds of undiscovered subtypes
moments.insight: Just as cancer went from 50 known types to hundreds, Steve predicts we'll soon map dozens of cognitive/neurodivergent subtypes we can't yet see.

moments.title: The one job every startup CEO actually has
moments.insight: Steve's blunt investor advice: a CEO's only real job is raising money, yet 99% of entrepreneurs only talk about what they care about, not what investors need to hear.
